Recycling is Mandatory Mandated Recyclables Make Recycling Easy

New Jersey passed the
Mandatory Source
Separation and Recycling
Act in 1987 requiring all
residents and businesses to
recycle. That established
the statewide recycling
goal of 50%.

Municipal Recycling Ordinance
Each Town has a Recycling Ordinance which
outlines recycling mandates for residents,
businesses and multi-family dwellings.

The following materials must be
recycled in Union County:
Aluminum, tin, & steel cans
Computers, TV’s & Monitors
Corrugated Cardboard
Fluorescent bulbs
Glass Bottles & Jars
Grass, Brush, Leaves
Rechargeable Batteries
Leaves
Mixed Paper
Masonry (asphalt, brick, block, concrete)
Motor Oil
Motor Oil Filters
Newspaper
Office Paper
Plastic Bottles & Containers (coded #1 & #2)
Tires
Vehicle Batteries
White Goods (air conditioners, refrigerators)
Wood
Your municipality/hauler may accept additional items
